task.title: To merge different versions of an agreement document

step.cmd: Go to the Work tab and select Compare. If you cannot see Compare under the Work tab, click the more icon () and from the menu, select Compare.

To compare agreement versions from the same agreement record, select a version in 'Select a version to compare or merge from' and then a different version from 'Select a version to compare or merge with' and click Merge.

info.p: A new document is downloaded in the Insert Comments and Track Changes mode. It contains the changes of the two versions, in which changes in both the documents are shown as tracked changes. If both versions have changes in the same smart field, the changes in the revised version are retained.

step.cmd: Open the document in X-Author Contracts for Cloud.

info.p: The document is locked and you will be able to Preview Reconcile, Mark Clause, Mark Field, Update from CLM, Validate Fields, Update Fields, Update Clauses and Promote Clause.

step.cmd: Right-click comment and select Accept Change or Reject Change based on your requirement.
You can make the required changes and check in the document to create a new version of the agreement document.
